en: A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) postcard view of a rural townscape across a calm river or pond. In the foreground is the water with grassy banks and some reeds; further back are fields, rows of trees, and a dirt road with utility poles. On the gently rising hills behind stand several detached houses and a building with a small tower or steeple, giving the impression of a small Central European village. The word "Zitzschewig" is printed in red in the upper left corner.
